verdicts.note: Reported full-year FY26 constant currency revenue growth was 3.1%, meeting the 3% to 3.5% guidance range.
verdicts.actual: full-year FY26 revenue growth was 3.1% in constant currency
verdicts.evidence_quote: We had growth of 3.1% for the full year in constant currency terms.

verdicts.note: Full-year operating margin reached 21%, falling within the guided 20% to 22% band.
verdicts.evidence_quote: So if you look at the margins, the full year margins is at 21%.

verdicts.note: Guidance was lowered to 1.5%-3% in July 2026 and further reduced to 1%-2% in October 2026.
verdicts.actual: guidance revised downward to 1% to 2% YoY
verdicts.evidence_quote: Based on our Q2 performance and revised outlook for rest of the year, our revenue growth guidance is 1% to 2% YoY .in constant currency terms.

verdicts.note: FY27 is ongoing; operating margin guidance continues to be maintained at 20% to 22%.
verdicts.evidence_quote: Our operating margin guidance remains at 20% to 22% for the year.

verdicts.note: FY27 horizon is ongoing; company hired about 13,000 freshers in H1 towards the 20,000 target.
verdicts.evidence_quote: We hired about 13,000 freshers in H1 in line with our target of approximately 20,000 for FY27.
